title: Testification
summary: TESTIFICA'TION, noun [Latin testificatio. See Testify.] The act of testifying or giving testimony or evidence; as a direct testification of our homage to God.

inlines.v: TESTIFICA'TION, noun [Latin testificatio. See Testify.] The act of testifying or giving testimony or evidence; as a direct testification of our homage to God.
